import cv2, numpy as np

img13 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0013.png')
# The grey couch/sideboard on the left:
# Color is grey: e.g. [78, 72, 69]
# In obs 13 (cam=(0, 0.9), facing +x):
# Let's find grey object pixels:
mask_grey = (img13[:,:,0] > 50) & (img13[:,:,0] < 90) & (img13[:,:,1] > 50) & (img13[:,:,1] < 90) & (img13[:,:,2] > 50) & (img13[:,:,2] < 90)
ys, xs = np.where(mask_grey & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 150))
print('obs 13 grey object: x in [', xs.min(), xs.max(), '], y in [', ys.min(), ys.max(), ']')
print('Bottom y in obs 13:', ys.max())

# Distance along +x in obs 13:
d_couch13 = 256 * 1.55 / (ys.max() - 255.5)
print(f'Grey object dist along +x in obs 13: {d_couch13:.2f} m')
"
